projects.name: Black Pearl
projects.quote: Construction of 300 MW data center at Black Pearl underway with expected energization in Q2 2025

projects.name: Reveille data center site
projects.quote: Acquisition of Reveille data center site with up to 200 MW of capacity well- suited for HPC data centers expected to close soon

projects.name: Three new North American sites (option to acquire)
projects.quote: In addition to constructing the 300 MW facility at Black Pearl, we are on track to close the acquisition of our new Reveille data center site with up to 200 MW of capacity and are pleased to announce we have executed a term sheet for an option to acquire three new sites with a cumulative power capacity of 1.5 GW.
